description: This Java interface 'CriteriaFactory' defines a builder pattern for creating various criteria and predicates used for querying documents within the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes methods for logical combinations (and, or, nor), existence checks, and common comparison predicates (eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, like, in).

classes.name: CriteriaFactory
classes.description: Interface for building criteria for querying documents.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Creates a Criteria matching any document, i.e., no filtering.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical AND of given criterias.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical OR of given criterias.

methods.name: nor
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical NOR of given criterias.

methods.name: nor (default method)
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical NOR of a single criteria.

methods.name: fieldCriteria
methods.description: Creates a criteria to filter based on a field value, using a given predicate.

methods.name: existsCriteria
methods.description: Creates a criteria to check if a field exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for equality.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for inequality.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a predicate for greater than comparison.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a predicate for greater than or equal.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a predicate for less than comparison.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a predicate for less than or equal.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a predicate for pattern matching.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a predicate that matches if a field's value is in a list of values.
